code: import os import json import time import random import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 浏览器配置 HEADLESS = True # 是否无头模式（不显示浏览器窗口） TIMEOUT = 30000 # 请求超时时间 (ms) # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): """确保目录存在""" if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径转换为绝对路径 (img src, a href) 2. 移除无用的脚本和样式标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 移除 script 和 style 标签 for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 移除懒加载属性，防止图片不显示 if img.get('loading'): del img['loading'] # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """解析日期字符串，支持多种格式""" date_str = date_str.strip() formats = [ "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%Y.%m.%d", "%Y年%m月%d日", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" ] for fmt in formats: try: return datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: continue return "" def is_date_in_range(date_str, start_date, end_date): """判断日期是否在范围内""" if not date_str: return False return start_date <= date_str <= end_date def extract_content_smart(page_content, base_url): """ 智能提取详情页正文 """ soup = BeautifulSoup(page_content, 'html.parser') # 常见的正文容器选择器 selectors = [ '.articleContent', '#articleContent', '.TRS_Editor', '.content', '#content', '.main_content', '.detail_content', 'div[class*="content"]', 'div[class*="article"]' ] content_html = "" # 1. 尝试精确匹配 for selector in selectors: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element: content_html = str(element) break # 2. 如果没找到，尝试查找文本最密集的 div if not content_html: divs = soup.find_all('div') max_p_count = 0 best_div = None for div in divs: p_count = len(div.find_all('p')) # 排除包含大量链接的导航栏 a_count = len(div.find_all('a')) if p_count > 3 and p_count > a_count: if p_count > max_p_count: max_p_count = p_count best_div = div if best_div: content_html = str(best_div) return clean_html_content(content_html, base_url) # ================= 核心爬虫逻辑 ================= def crawl_news(): """主爬虫函数""" ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) results = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=HEADLESS, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) # 注入脚本以绕过 webdriver 检测 context.add_init_script(""" Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined }); """) page = context.new_page() print(f"[*] 开始爬取: {TARGET_URL}") print(f"[*] 目标时间范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") try: page.goto(TARGET_URL, timeout=TIMEOUT, wait_until="domcontentloaded") page.wait_for_timeout(2000) # 等待页面稳定 except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 无法打开首页: {e}") return [] has_next_page = True page_num = 1 stop_crawling = False while has_next_page and not stop_crawling: print(f"--- 正在处理第 {page_num} 页 ---") # 等待列表加载 try: page.wait_for_selector('div.rightListContent', timeout=5000) except: print("[Warn] 未找到列表元素，可能已到末尾或页面结构变化") break # 获取当前页所有列表项 items = page.query_selector_all('div.rightListContent') print(f"[*] 当前页发现 {len(items)} 条记录") current_page_valid_count = 0 consecutive_out_of_range = 0 # 提取当前页数据 page_data = [] for item in items: try: # 提取日期 date_el = item.query_selector('.rightListTime') date_text = date_el.inner_text().strip() if date_el else "" pub_date = parse_date(date_text) # 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.query_selector('.rightListImport a') if not link_el: continue title = link_el.get_attribute('title') or link_el.inner_text().strip() relative_link = link_el.get_attribute('href') full_link = urljoin(page.url, relative_link) # 日期逻辑判断 if not pub_date: print(f"[Skip] 日期解析失败: {title}") continue if pub_date > END_DATE: # 日期在未来（相对于结束日期），跳过继续往后找 continue if pub_date < START_DATE: # 日期早于开始日期 consecutive_out_of_range += 1 # 如果连续 10 条记录都早于开始日期，且不是置顶（这里假设列表大致有序），则停止 # 考虑到可能有置顶，我们宽松一点，只在确定是旧数据时计数 if consecutive_out_of_range >= 10: print(f"[*] 连续多条记录日期({pub_date})早于开始日期({START_DATE})，停止翻页") stop_crawling = True break continue # 符合日期范围 consecutive_out_of_range = 0 # 重置计数器 current_page_valid_count += 1 page_data.append({ "title": title, "date": pub_date, "url": full_link, "source": "中国债券信息网", "author": "中国债券信息网" # 默认值 }) except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 提取列表项失败: {e}") continue # 将当前页符合条件的加入待爬取队列（暂不爬详情，先收集链接） results.extend(page_data) print(f"[*] 第 {page_num} 页提取到 {len(page_data)} 条符合条件的数据") if stop_crawling: break # 翻页逻辑 try: # 查找下一页按钮 # 根据HTML结构: next_btn = page.query_selector('a.pageNext') # 检查下一页按钮是否有效（有些网站最后一页按钮会变灰或消失） # 这里检查它是否有 href 属性或者是否可点击 if next_btn: # 检查是否是最后一页：通常最后一页的下一页按钮没有 href 或者 class 包含 disabled href = next_btn.get_attribute('href') class_attr = next_btn.get_attribute('class') or "" if not href or "disabled" in class_attr or "javascript:void(0)" in href: print("[*] 没有下一页了 (按钮无效)") has_next_page = False else: print("[*] 跳转下一页...") # 强制点击，即使元素被遮挡 next_btn.click(force=True) page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle") page.wait_for_timeout(1500) # 额外等待 page_num += 1 else: print("[*] 未找到下一页按钮") has_next_page = False except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 翻页失败: {e}") has_next_page = False print(f"[*] 列表采集完成，共获取 {len(results)} 条链接，开始采集详情页...") # 采集详情页内容 for i, article in enumerate(results): print(f"[{i+1}/{len(results)}] 正在采集: {article['title']}") try: page.goto(article['url'], timeout=TIMEOUT) page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded") # 提取正文 content_html = page.content() article['content'] = extract_content_smart(content_html, article['url']) # 提取摘要（前200字） soup = BeautifulSoup(article['content'], 'html.parser') text_content = soup.get_text(strip=True) article['summary'] = text_content[:200] + "..." if len(text_content) > 200 else text_content # 随机等待，避免请求过快 time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 2)) except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 详情页采集失败 {article['url']}: {e}") article['content'] = "" article['summary'] = "" browser.close() return results def save_results(articles): """保存结果为JSON""" if not articles: print("[*] 没有采集到数据，不生成文件") return timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) result_data = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": f"{START_DATE} to {END_DATE}", "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result_data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"\n[Success] 结果已保存至: {output_path}") print(f"共保存 {len(articles)} 条数据") except Exception as e: print(f"[Error] 保存文件失败: {e}") def main(): print("=== 中国债券信息网新闻爬虫启动 ===") start_time = time.time() try: articles = crawl_news() save_results(articles) except KeyboardInterrupt: print("\n[!] 用户中断爬虫") except Exception as e: print(f"\n[Error] 爬虫运行出错: {e}") duration = time.time() - start_time print(f"=== 爬虫结束，耗时: {duration:.2f} 秒 ===") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
